events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us some of the most memorable comedy moments in British history. Happy 87th to a true legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. What's your favourite track from this iconic record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: This day marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles pushed boundaries with 'Rubber Soul'. A truly influential album.

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Imagine Forever
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message continue to resonate worldwide, 46 years after his passing.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary innovator David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. His impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Hail to the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. Long live the King!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The man behind some of rock's most iconic riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The inimitable British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, frontman of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs from Madness! Here's to more 'One Step Beyond' years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Young At Heart
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the voice behind some of the 80s' biggest hits, Paul Young!

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, who passed away in August 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Enduring Sparkle
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we remember the one and only Dolly Parton, a true force of nature in music and beyond.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Barlow's Brilliance
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true pop maestro.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! Still got us dancing.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held, honouring legends like The Beatles and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years since the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would you induct into the Hall of Fame today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Sending love to the Take That star.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rock
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true powerhouse of music.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American pop superstar, singer, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT's Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the 'Prince of Pop', Justin Timberlake! Still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to Sir David Jason! A true national treasure who has brought joy to millions. Lovely Jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: This day marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash in 1959 that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Remembering Rock Pioneers
angles.copy: 68 years ago, music lost three stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop sensation Rick Astley, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Here's to another year of timeless tunes and unexpected comebacks.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. Turn up the reggae!

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The influential American singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius and a voice that defined a generation.

events.title: Whitney Houston tribute
events.blurb: This day marks 15 years since the passing of the iconic singer Whitney Houston in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering Whitney Houston, 15 years on. Her incredible voice continues to inspire and move millions.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, millions of fans were heartbroken as British pop giants Take That announced their split.

angles.name: That Day in Pop History
angles.copy: It's been 31 years since Take That's original split. A day that changed pop music forever, but thankfully, they're back!
